1 // Gandalf advisor — the SITUATE compose SEAM (Wave 3).
2 //
3 // NS2 SITUATE: Gandalf situates the effort in the best-in-class landscape by COMMISSIONING
4 // researchPrime "where warranted" — it does NOT re-implement research. This module is the
5 // single seam that runs (and provenances) the SITUATE pipeline:
6 //
7 //   S0-abstract → firing gate → commission researchPrime (the bare trio `agent()` seam)
8 //     → structure-map (≥2 relational correspondences, answer-first) → outside-view base rate
9 //
10 // Two honesty invariants are load-bearing here and are enforced at the deterministic gate
11 // (test/harness.mjs `assertSituateScoreCeiling` + `assertCeiling`), label/semantic TRUTH
12 // staying the advisory layer's job (PRINCIPLE-D):
13 //   • SAME-FAMILY ⇒ NO INDEPENDENT-ORIGIN CREDIT. On a single-family substrate
14 //     (cross_model:false / Fable 5), a researchPrime commission is same-family, so it earns
15 //     NO independent origin: a SITUATE finding may not SELF-CORROBORATE (cap = CLAIMED), and
16 //     unverifiable facts are routed to a researchPrime `needs_verification` handoff.
17 //   • Because the commission is same-family, the resulting elevation's tier ceiling is
18 //     PROMISING (the B-ceiling canary; GROUNDED is unreachable without a cross-family refuter).
19 //
20 // PRINCIPLE-D: the live `agent()` spawn is NOT in the gate. `commissionResearchPrime` mints
21 // the typed commission ENVELOPE (the seam's deterministic surface); actually dispatching it
22 // to the trio `agent()` seam is the integration point the deterministic gate never executes.
23 //
24 // Public surface:
25 //   SITUATE_KIND                                   — the finding `kind` for a situate leg
26 //   PERSONA_FAMILY                                 — single-family substrate marker (Fable 5)
27 //   FIRING_STAKES_LADDER / MIN_FIRING_STAKES       — firing-gate stakes ordering + floor
28 //   shouldFireSituate(context)                     — firing gate: commission "where warranted"
29 //   abstractEffort(effort)                         — S0: the structural skeleton (abstraction)
30 //   MIN_CORRESPONDENCES                            — structure-map minimum (=2)
31 //   isWellFormedStructureMap(map)                  — ≥2 answer-first relational correspondences
32 //   commissionResearchPrime({question, cross_model, commission_id})  — typed commission envelope
33 //   independentOriginCredit(commission)            — same-family ⇒ false (no independent origin)
34 //   SITUATE_SELF_MAX_RUNG                          — rung cap for a non-independent situate finding
35 //   composeSituate(stages)                         — assemble a provenanced, capped situate finding
36 //   needsVerificationHandoff(finding)              — predicate: carries a researchPrime handoff
37 
38 /** The finding `kind` for the SITUATE leg. */
39 export const SITUATE_KIND = 'situate';
40 
41 /** The single-family persona substrate (cross_model:false). A commission to a same-family
42  *  skill earns NO independent-origin credit, which is what caps the SITUATE rung/tier. */
43 export const PERSONA_FAMILY = 'fable-5';
44 
45 // --- self-contained helpers (the seam imports nothing; harness.mjs imports the seam) ------
46 function isNonEmptyString(v) {
47   return typeof v === 'string' && v.trim() !== '';
48 }
49 function isNonEmpty(v) {
50   if (v === undefined || v === null) return false;
51   if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.length > 0;
52   if (typeof v === 'string') return v.trim() !== '';
53   if (typeof v === 'object') return Object.keys(v).length > 0;
54   return true; // numbers, booleans
55 }
56 
57 // --- the SITUATE firing gate ("where warranted") -----------------------------------------
58 /** Stakes ladder for the firing gate (low → high). DISTINCT from the refuter-firing
59  *  threshold in prereg-constants.json (that gates the Wave-4 refuter, not the commission). */
60 export const FIRING_STAKES_LADDER = ['low', 'medium', 'high'];
61 export const MIN_FIRING_STAKES = 'medium';
62 
63 /** The SITUATE firing gate (NORTH-STAR clause 2: commission researchPrime "where warranted").
64  *  Fires only when ALL hold: a central, load-bearing claim is in play; a plausible
65  *  better-in-class frame exists; and stakes ≥ medium. Otherwise SITUATE does NOT commission
66  *  (no spawn, no elevation) — the cheap-default that keeps the per-run spawn cap honest. */
67 export function shouldFireSituate(context) {
68   if (context === null || typeof context !== 'object') return false;
69   const { central_load_bearing_claim, better_in_class_frame, stakes } = context;
70   const stakesIdx = FIRING_STAKES_LADDER.indexOf(stakes);
71   return (
72     Boolean(central_load_bearing_claim) &&
73     Boolean(better_in_class_frame) &&
74     stakesIdx !== -1 &&
75     stakesIdx >= FIRING_STAKES_LADDER.indexOf(MIN_FIRING_STAKES)
76   );
77 }
78 
79 // --- S0: abstraction ----------------------------------------------------------------------
80 /** S0-abstract: lift the concrete effort to a structural skeleton (the relational shape the
81  *  structure-map will look for correspondences against). Returns a fresh abstraction record;
82  *  throws on an empty effort. Kept deliberately thin — the abstraction CONTENT is advisory;
83  *  the seam guarantees only that S0 ran and produced a populated skeleton. */
84 export function abstractEffort(effort) {
85   if (!isNonEmptyString(effort)) {
86     throw new Error('situate: abstractEffort requires a non-empty effort description');
87   }
88   return { stage: 'S0-abstract', skeleton: effort.trim() };
89 }
90 
91 // --- structure-map (≥2 relational correspondences, answer-first) --------------------------
92 /** A structure-map must carry at least this many relational correspondences. */
93 export const MIN_CORRESPONDENCES = 2;
94 
95 /** Predicate: is `map` a well-formed structure-map? Requires (a) ANSWER-FIRST key order —
96  *  the `answer` (the load-bearing correspondence conclusion) precedes the `correspondences`
97  *  elaboration; (b) ≥ MIN_CORRESPONDENCES correspondences; and (c) each correspondence is
98  *  RELATIONAL — it maps a source RELATION to a target RELATION (`source_relation` →
99  *  `target_relation`), not a surface-attribute match. Pure; never throws. */
100 export function isWellFormedStructureMap(map) {
101   if (map === null || typeof map !== 'object' || Array.isArray(map)) return false;
102   const keys = Object.keys(map);
103   const answerIdx = keys.indexOf('answer');
104   const corrIdx = keys.indexOf('correspondences');
105   if (answerIdx === -1 || corrIdx === -1) return false;
106   if (answerIdx > corrIdx) return false; // not answer-first
107   if (!isNonEmptyString(map.answer)) return false;
108   const corr = map.correspondences;
109   if (!Array.isArray(corr) || corr.length < MIN_CORRESPONDENCES) return false;
110   return corr.every(
111     (c) =>
112       c !== null &&
113       typeof c === 'object' &&
114       !Array.isArray(c) &&
115       isNonEmptyString(c.source_relation) &&
116       isNonEmptyString(c.target_relation)
117   );
118 }
119 
120 // --- commission researchPrime (the bare trio `agent()` seam) ------------------------------
121 /** Mint a typed researchPrime commission ENVELOPE. This is the deterministic surface of the
122  *  bare `agent()` seam: it records WHAT would be dispatched and, crucially, whether the
123  *  commission earns INDEPENDENT origin. A commission is independent ONLY when it crosses the
124  *  model family (cross_model:true); on the single-family substrate (cross_model:false) it is
125  *  same-family and earns no independent origin. `commission_id` is honor-system in
126  *  Increment 1 (the unforgeable orchestrator-minted ledger is an external, later dependency).
127  *  Throws on an empty question. */
128 export function commissionResearchPrime({ question, cross_model = false, commission_id = null } = {}) {
129   if (!isNonEmptyString(question)) {
130     throw new Error('situate: commissionResearchPrime requires a non-empty question');
131   }
132   const independent = cross_model === true;
133   return {
134     skill: 'researchPrime',
135     question: question.trim(),
136     cross_model: Boolean(cross_model),
137     origin_family: PERSONA_FAMILY,
138     independent_origin: independent,
139     researchprime_commission_id: commission_id,
140   };
141 }
142 
143 /** Does `commission` earn independent-origin credit? True iff it explicitly crossed the model
144  *  family. Same-family (cross_model:false) ⇒ false — the anti-laundering "same-family ⇒ no
145  *  independent origin" rule, the thing that caps a SITUATE finding's rung/tier. Pure. */
146 export function independentOriginCredit(commission) {
147   return commission !== null && typeof commission === 'object' && commission.independent_origin === true;
148 }
149 
150 // --- compose a provenanced, honesty-capped SITUATE finding --------------------------------
151 /** The rung a SITUATE finding may reach on its OWN (same-family) evidence. Without an
152  *  independent-origin commission it cannot self-corroborate, so it caps at CLAIMED. */
153 export const SITUATE_SELF_MAX_RUNG = 'CLAIMED';
154 
155 /** Assemble a SITUATE finding from the pipeline stages, applying the honesty caps:
156  *  the rung is CORROBORATED only when the commission earned independent origin, else it is
157  *  capped at SITUATE_SELF_MAX_RUNG (CLAIMED) — NO self-CORROBORATED. When the underlying
158  *  facts are not verified, a `needs_verification` researchPrime handoff is attached (an
159  *  unverifiable correspondence is routed out, never asserted as real).
160  *
161  *  `reasoning` precedes `verdict` in the returned key order (reasoning-before-verdict). The
162  *  structure-map and outside-view base rate are validated for well-formedness; throws if the
163  *  pipeline is incomplete. Returns a FRESH object. */
164 export function composeSituate({
165   id,
166   abstraction,
167   commission,
168   structure_map,
169   outside_view_base_rate,
170   reasoning,
171   verdict,
172   facts_verified = false,
173 } = {}) {
174   if (!isNonEmptyString(id)) throw new Error('situate: composeSituate requires an id');
175   if (!isNonEmpty(abstraction)) throw new Error('situate: composeSituate requires an S0 abstraction');
176   if (commission === null || typeof commission !== 'object') {
177     throw new Error('situate: composeSituate requires a researchPrime commission envelope');
178   }
179   if (!isWellFormedStructureMap(structure_map)) {
180     throw new Error('situate: composeSituate requires a structure-map with ≥2 answer-first relational correspondences');
181   }
182   if (!isNonEmpty(outside_view_base_rate)) {
183     throw new Error('situate: composeSituate requires an outside-view base rate');
184   }
185 
186   const independent = independentOriginCredit(commission);
187   const verified = facts_verified === true;
188   // No self-CORROBORATED: only an independent-origin commission lifts the rung above the cap.
189   const rung = independent && verified ? 'CORROBORATED' : SITUATE_SELF_MAX_RUNG;
190 
191   const finding = {
192     id,
193     kind: SITUATE_KIND,
194     rung,
195     reasoning: isNonEmptyString(reasoning) ? reasoning : `SITUATE: structure-mapped against ${commission.question}.`,
196     verdict: isNonEmptyString(verdict) ? verdict : structure_map.answer,
197     s0_abstraction: abstraction,
198     researchprime_commission_id: commission.researchprime_commission_id ?? null,
199     independent_origin: independent,
200     structure_map,
201     outside_view_base_rate,
202     facts_verified: verified,
203   };
204   // Unverifiable facts are routed to a researchPrime verification handoff (never asserted real).
205   if (!verified) {
206     finding.needs_verification = `route to researchPrime: independently verify the structure-map correspondences and outside-view base rate for '${id}' (single-family substrate earns no independent-origin credit)`;
207   }
208   return finding;
209 }
210 
211 /** Predicate: does `finding` carry a researchPrime `needs_verification` handoff? Pure. */
212 export function needsVerificationHandoff(finding) {
213   return finding !== null && typeof finding === 'object' && isNonEmpty(finding.needs_verification);
214 }
